page.overview:
Who is Anirul?

For the wife of Shaddam, see Anirul Corrino. Anirul was a thinking machine used by Tula Harkonnen to keep Lila Cho Grace Na-Berto Anirul alive.

After Raquella's death, Valya decided to show Kasha, Francesca, and Tula Anirul, who housed the breeding index. They consulted with her to find the match that would be most advantageous for the Sisterhood. She brought up Javicco Corrino as the father and Natalya Arat as the mother. Valya then had Kasha and Francesca leave so she could show Tula her baby's genetics, which showed that he could shape the trajectory of the world.

Unable to let Lila go, Tula hooked Lila up to Anirul to keep her alive in the storeroom. She had Anirul run diagnostics. When Anirul gave her Lila's vitals, Tula told Anirul to administer spice. Then she further ordered Anirul to keep Lila alive.

When Tula received the blood sample from Valya from Desmond Hart, she gave it to Anirul to run. Tula was shocked when she identified him as being Atreides and Harkonnen and finally identified him as the son of Tula and Orry.
